feedback: This initial geometry provides a stable, well-sensed platform with a balanced sensor array and moderate dimensions. The controller compensates with moderate PID gains and symmetric sensor weights to steer accurately. If the next race shows frequent line loss events or high rms error, consider adjusting sensor positions to improve line coverage or increasing sensor size for better detection. If the robot oscillates or shows unstable steering, reduce kp or kd gains or narrow the wheel track to improve responsiveness. If the robot finishes with low progress or stalls, consider increasing base speed or reducing mass to improve acceleration and speed.
requested_changes: sensor_size: 0.016 to increase line detection area, based on evidence that larger sensors reduce line loss in prior races
wheel_track: reduce to 0.12 m to improve turning agility if steering oscillation is high, supported by earlier observations of wide tracks causing sluggish turns
body_length: increase to 0.20 m to improve stability and off-track tolerance if max_error is large, as longer bodies help maintain line following in curves
